summary: Open-source command-line tool that hunts for social media accounts by username across 400+ sites.
access_note: Local CLI only; no hosted API.
blocker_note: No hosted API; only a local CLI (a community MCP wrapper and Apify Actors exist).

evidence.quote: Hunt down social media accounts by username across social networks.
Accounts found will be stored in an individual text file with the corresponding username
Seamlessly search social media accounts across 400+ platforms using the Model Context Protocol.

notes: The install quote is slightly adapted from fetched summary text; verify. Community MCP wraps the local CLI. Apify hosts Sherlock Actors (netmilk/sherlock) as an alternative path.
